repro_plan: Start the pipeline CLI in a clean subprocess whose environment omits the Azure endpoint and API-key variables and whose runner directory has no local .env file.
Request top-level help and help for the bug subcommand; record each process exit code and stderr without allowing any network or model call.
Assert that each help request exits with code 0, prints argparse usage for the requested command, and emits no credential exception or traceback.
Run the same regression with minimal dummy Azure variables as a control so parser construction and the bug subcommand's help text are independently verified.
